headline: Linkup’s SPARSEUP fills sparse retrieval’s model slot, but trails matched dense and late-interaction alternatives on BEIR
summary: Linkup Research released SPARSEUP, a 149M-parameter English sparse retriever based on ModernBERT and fine-tuned with the same data family as LightOn’s DenseOn and LateOn. It fills the sparse-model slot and exposes vocabulary-linked weights for inspection. In the company’s BEIR-13 comparison excluding MS MARCO, SPARSEUP scored 56.36 nDCG@10 versus DenseOn’s 57.88, while remaining behind LateOn. The comparison is not fully retrieval-matched: SPARSEUP used approximate Seismic search and the LightOn comparators used exact search. Linkup also reports sub-millisecond MS MARCO latency at greater than 97% recall with Seismic, on dedicated infrastructure. These are first-party benchmark and latency claims, not an independent reproduction.
